title: Null control: Tokyo temp vs corn returns
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Tokyo mean temperature 20d z-score is unrelated to ZC=F log returns at lags 0-10 days (null control); no trade [weather.tokyo.temp_mean -> finance.ZC=F.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.tokyo.temp_mean rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long ZC=F next session

trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
